scope.audioEdits: 548 MP3 files unchanged; nine neutral-tone Float32 WAV files converted to PCM16 without trimming, resampling or gain changes.
scope.selection: Each existing curriculum reading is matched to the publisher's exact Bopomofo/pinyin mapping, preserving every tone and ü.
scope.speakerIdentity: Personal speaker identity and native-language biography are not published in the archive.
scope.validationLimit: Publisher-labeled pronunciation references, not a fluent-listener certification or an ASR tone judgment. Isolated readings do not model tone sandhi in phrases.
excluded: All female recordings (female e/er tones 1–4 duplicate distinct labels).
Bundled M_nu3.mp3 and M_lu4.mp3 (wrong u/ü duplicates; replaced with labeled numbered source files).
Unused male lu/lv tones 1–3, luan/lvan tones 2–3 and nu/nv tones 2/4 also collide; not imported.
MOE long dictionary narration, TTS candidates, PSOLA controls and ASR predictions are not these reference assets.
